text.en:
The Philippine Center on Transnational Crime (PCTC) is
placed under the direct supervision and control of the Department of the Interior
and Local Government.

. All orders, rules, regulations, and issuances, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 20th
the year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
Ari A levery
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
